description: Metrics extracted by ai/equity_facts from BIDV (BID) and MB (MBB) financial statements. The backend reads this file (EquityFacts:MetricCatalogPath) to know which metrics are expected per group; code/group/statement/core/unit/labels keys are stable. Metrics with optional=true are auxiliary (validation components) and are not counted as expected coverage.

periodConventions.pointInTime: balance-sheet and note balances: PeriodType point-in-time, PeriodLabel = quarter of the balance date (31/12/2025 -> 2025Q4), PeriodStart null
periodConventions.quarter: quarter column of a quarterly report: 'YYYYQn', PeriodType quarter
periodConventions.ytd: cumulative column of a quarterly report: 'YYYY-3M'|'YYYY-6M'|'YYYY-9M', PeriodType ytd; the 12-month cumulative column of a Q4 (unaudited) report is 'YYYY' with PeriodType ytd so it never collides with the audited annual report
periodConventions.value: Value is the printed number (sign as printed, parentheses = negative), Scale = VND per printed unit (triệu đồng = 1000000), Unit VND

metrics.notes: Older layouts print it as an of-which line ("+ Trong đó ... tại MBS"), sometimes inside group 1 and sometimes outside: the loan-group identity decides by exact arithmetic (groups 1-5 = total -> of-which, line dropped; groups 1-5 + this line = total -> separate line).
